question: In the Union Budget presented on 1 February 2025, what was the new income threshold up to which individuals are exempted from paying income tax under the new regime?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**₹12 lakh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Budget** presented on **1 February 2025** introduced revisions to the income tax structure under the **new regime**.
 
• Individuals earning up to **₹12 lakh** annually were exempted from paying income tax, representing an effort to provide **financial relief** and incentivize the adoption of the new tax regime.
 
• This adjustment reflects the government's focus on enhancing **disposable income** for the middle class and boosting **economic activity**.
 
• The new exemption threshold aligns with the government's broader vision to simplify tax compliance and encourage more taxpayers to shift to the **new tax regime**.
 
• The revised limit of **₹12 lakh** is higher compared to previous thresholds, providing significant relief to salaried individuals and small business owners.
 
• Such measures also aim to promote **consumer spending**, which is a critical driver of economic growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **₹10 lakh**__

 __
 
• Earlier budgets had set exemption thresholds closer to **₹10 lakh**, but with rising inflation and evolving economic conditions, this limit was deemed insufficient.
 
• While it might have been relevant previously, the government opted for a higher threshold to cater to the growing financial needs of individuals.
 
 
 
• **₹15 lakh**__
 __
 
• Although a limit of **₹15 lakh** might seem attractive, it was not implemented as it could result in significant revenue loss for the government.
 
• The focus remained on balancing tax relief and maintaining fiscal stability.
 
 
 
• **₹12.75 lakh**__
 
 
• This threshold is not part of the government’s considerations for exemption levels, as the finalized limit was rounded to **₹12 lakh** for simplicity and effective implementation.
